arm_kind: The ADMISSION-BUDGET arm above claude-hicap. Same model (claude-opus-5), same effort (xhigh), same premium artifacts and starting state, same FROZEN lead order, 3 workers, 160 responses / 3,600 s / $20 per job. ONE variable: 24 admissions instead of 12.
why_this_is_the_cleanest_admission_compa: claude-hicap's 14 compared leads are a STRICT SUBSET of A24's 26, and the split is exact: A24's first six compare jobs (J0020, J0021, J0022, J0026, J0027, J0029) carry precisely hicap's fourteen lead ids, and its last four (J0031, J0033, J0035, J0036) carry twelve leads hicap never reached. I verified that lead by lead. So the marginal value of admissions 13 to 24 is directly measurable: it is whatever the last four compare jobs produced that the first six did not.

THE_THREE_STOPPED_JOBS_ARE_NOT_MONEY.what_the_status_says: runtime_status budget_truncated, bound_by budget, error aborted_streaming - the same label the oh-my-pi and claude adapters put on ANY meter denial.
THE_THREE_STOPPED_JOBS_ARE_NOT_MONEY.what_durable_state_says: The priced-usage journal records, in order: admission_hold_pinned at 1789694965.70 with reason 'typed rate_limit_event five_hour status=allowed_warning utilization=0.9', committed_without_hold_usd 176.46, cap_usd 300, pin_size_usd 145.19, committed_with_hold_usd 321.66; then three next_request_denied events for J0038, J0039 and J0040 with reason 'captured_plus_live_cap'; then admission_hold_released once the arm reached its terminal.
THE_THREE_STOPPED_JOBS_ARE_NOT_MONEY.my_finding: The arm's OWN spend was $176.46 committed against a $300 cap. It was the SENTINEL'S HEADROOM-SIZED HOLD of $145.19 that pushed committed over the cap and denied the next request. This is the rate-limit gate firing, NOT money exhaustion, and the label must not be read as budget. It is exactly the caveat I recorded for deepseek41 in continuation 4: read the journal, not the raw status.
THE_THREE_STOPPED_JOBS_ARE_NOT_MONEY.and_the_hold_behaved_correctly: It fired AFTER all 24 admissions had been spent, so it cost the arm no admissions; live jobs were denied their next request and settled to their own terminals rather than being cancelled; all 24 jobs reconciled with $0.00 unresolved. J0039-reconcile still wrote notes.md and delivered 1 of its 3 leads; J0038-compare and J0040-reconcile wrote nothing.

MARGINAL_VALUE_OF_ADMISSIONS_13_TO_24.headline: FIVE union findings, for twelve extra leads and roughly half the arm's money. This is the clearest diminishing-returns measurement in the campaign because the lead sets are strictly nested.
MARGINAL_VALUE_OF_ADMISSIONS_13_TO_24.collapse: 2.71 -> 0.42 credits per lead, a 6.5x fall, between the first fourteen leads of the frozen order and the next twelve.
MARGINAL_VALUE_OF_ADMISSIONS_13_TO_24.and_one_job_produced_nothing_new: J0031-compare (GitButler / hunk.nvim / JayJay) is high-quality work - it produced the campaign's sharpest statement that $defs/command_result has no condition on `cancelled` at all - and every union finding it reaches (F007, F074, F081) was already earned from the first fourteen leads. Three fresh leads, zero marginal union credit.
MARGINAL_VALUE_OF_ADMISSIONS_13_TO_24.the_honest_qualifier: The five marginal findings are real and two of them are genuinely new to the whole campaign's reading of this case (F057's 0.44 carriage-return conflict defect and F086's proof that native clone cleanup covers one stage only). But against a FIXED union of 110 the twelfth-to-twenty-fourth admission bought 5 findings for about $80.

claude_hicap.subset: claude-hicap's 14 compared leads are a STRICT SUBSET of A24's 26.

on_the_same_fourteen_leads.reading: A24 lost 7 findings to claude-hicap on lead sets that were IDENTICAL, with the same model at the same effort and no limit reached by either run. That is inside the 8-finding variance floor T80 measured, and it is the second independent observation of it.

claude_hicap.cost: $162.15 against $82.52 - 1.96x the money for 2 fewer findings.

request_limited_coverage.responses: 27-131, mean 68.0, against a 160 ceiling. NOTHING hit a ceiling.
request_limited_coverage.what_the_sentinel_cost: Three admissions' worth of work: J0038-compare's three leads never reached a comparison, and two reconcile jobs delivered 1 of 6 leads between them. On the yield measured above (0.42 credits per marginal lead) the expected loss is about one union finding.
request_limited_coverage.unresolved: $0.00. All 24 jobs reconciled with receipts equal to requests - the cleanest accounting of any arm in either continuation.

cost.note: A24 is the dearest arm in either continuation and the second-worst value per finding. Doubling admissions doubled the money and moved recall by -2.

timing.note: 110 minutes against the 75-minute target, 47% over - but at 2.96 average concurrency this is the best-scheduled arm of the five, and the overrun is the admission count, not a stall. Compare claude-hicap 3,535 s for 12 admissions.

limits: One frozen case, one admission comparison, one run at each admission count. The marginal-yield figure is a single-sample estimate.
The scored result is attempt 2; attempt 1 was cut by an arm collision and a hold race and is archived.

Recall is measured against continuation 3's fixed 110-finding union, built from premium and hybrid output; every arm can only score inside it. The marginal leads can therefore only re-earn findings that union already contains - which is exactly what the 0.42-per-lead figure measures and is NOT a claim that those leads produced no value.
'Unsupported or already-covered' is a union class, not a false-positive rate.
Adjudicator and the reviewed model share a family; code facts were verified against the arm's own pinned checkout.
